root_cause.text: Incomplete error handling in gfs2_fill_super and gfs2_make_fs_rw fails to clean up allocated kernel threads and quota bitmap when transitioning a filesystem to read-write mode fails, specifically when gfs2_freeze_lock_shared fails after init_threads or when gfs2_make_fs_rw's quota initialization succeeds but the filesystem is withdrawn, leading to memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `gfs2_destroy_threads(sdp)` to the `fail_per_node` label to ensure threads are destroyed in all error paths (previously only called after gfs2_make_fs_rw failure but not after gfs2_freeze_lock_shared failure). It also adds `gfs2_quota_cleanup(sdp)` inside `gfs2_make_fs_rw` when `gfs2_withdrawn(sdp)` is true after `gfs2_quota_init()` succeeds, preventing the quota bitmap leak. The CVE description and backtraces confirm these leak scenarios.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix improper early cleanup of threads in gfs2_fill_super error path to avoid potential resource management bugs.
intent_record.what: Removed call to gfs2_destroy_threads(sdp) from the error handling block when making FS RW fails, between gfs2_freeze_unlock and the error message.
intent_record.how: This prevents premature destruction of threads when an error occurs; threads will instead be destroyed later in the fail_per_node label, avoiding potential double-free or use-after-free issues.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing cleanup of threads in the error path of gfs2_fill_super to prevent resource leak.
intent_record.what: Added a call to gfs2_destroy_threads(sdp) in the fail_per_node error path of gfs2_fill_super, right after init_per_node(sdp, UNDO) and before the fail_inodes label.
intent_record.how: Ensures that when superblock initialization fails after threads have been created, the threads are properly cleaned up, preventing resource leaks or incomplete shutdown.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix resource leak by calling gfs2_quota_cleanup when gfs2_quota_init succeeds but the filesystem is withdrawn.
intent_record.what: Added call to gfs2_quota_cleanup(sdp) and braces inside the if block that sets error = -EIO when gfs2_quota_init succeeded but the filesystem is withdrawn.
intent_record.how: Prevents resource leak by cleaning up quota initialization when the filesystem is in a withdrawn state, ensuring proper teardown of resources allocated by gfs2_quota_init.
